stops.name: Dauner Maare
stops.detail: The nature reserve Dauner Maare is located in the district Vulkaneifel in Rhineland-Palatinate on the territory of the city of Daun and the local community Schalkenmehren. The area extends east and southeast of the Daun district of Gemünden. Through the area and at its northern edge runs the provincial road L 64, at the western edge the L 46 and northeast the B 421. Not far west of the area flows the Lieser, a left tributary of the Moselle.
